The '''GDW Weaponcarrier''' was a model of armed [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] that was used during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The GDW Weaponcarrier was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> It was added to the game in Game Update 7.7.1 as a reward for subscribers with an active account between [[September 9]] and [[October 14]], [[2025]].<ref name="update">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20250909|text=The GDW Weaponcarrier mount and Login Reward event will soon be available for Subscribers}}</ref>
